mapper.sql: FROM apr16_stamp_doc LEFT JOIN emp01_Person ON emp01_person_id = apr16_appl_emp_id LEFT JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr16_stamp_id LEFT JOIN apr15_repr_corp ON apr15_repr_corp_id = apr16_repr_corp_id LEFT JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = apr16_repr_corp_id LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr16_appr_id WHERE apr16_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr16_reg_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{closeDate}::date
mapper.select:
SELECT apr16_stamp_doc_id AS stamp_doc_id , apr16_company_id AS company_id , apr16_reg_date AS reg_date , apr16_appl_type AS appl_type , f_cdnm('CorpDocStampApplType', apr16_appl_type, apr16_company_id, #{startDate}::date) AS appl_type_name , apr16_stamp_id AS stamp_id , apr16_repr_corp_id AS repr_corp_id , CASE WHEN apr16_appl_type = '2' THEN COALESCE(apr15_corp_nm, sys01_company_nm) ELSE apr10_stamp_nm END AS stamp_repr_corp_name , apr16_doc_issue_qty AS doc_issue_qty , apr16_doc_appl_qty AS doc_appl_qty , apr16_doc_use_qty AS doc_use_qty , apr16_provide_co AS provide_co , apr16_purpose AS purpose , apr16_requester AS requester , apr16_note AS note , apr16_appl_date AS appl_date , emp01_kor_nm AS appl_emp_name , apr16_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_title AS appr_name , CASE WHEN apr01_appr_id IS NULL THEN null ELSE f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr16_company_id, #{startDate}::date) END AS appr_status_name
AND apr16_appl_type = #{applType}
AND apr16_appl_type IN ('1','2')
AND (( #{applType} = '1' AND apr16_stamp_id = #{stampReprCorpId}) OR (#{applType} = '2' AND apr16_repr_corp_id = #{stampReprCorpId}))
ORDER BY apr16_reg_date DESC, apr16_stamp_doc_id DESC

SELECT apr16_stamp_doc_id AS stamp_doc_id , apr16_appl_date AS appl_date , emp01_kor_nm AS appl_emp_name , apr16_provide_co AS provide_co , apr16_purpose AS purpose , apr16_appl_type AS appl_type , f_cdnm('CorpDocStampApplType', apr16_appl_type, apr16_company_id, f_today()) AS appl_type_name , CASE WHEN apr16_appl_type = '2' THEN COALESCE(apr15_corp_nm, sys01_company_nm) ELSE apr10_stamp_nm END AS stamp_repr_corp_name , apr16_doc_appl_qty AS doc_appl_qty FROM apr16_stamp_doc LEFT JOIN emp01_Person ON emp01_person_id = apr16_appl_emp_id LEFT JOIN apr10_stamp ON apr10_stamp_id = apr16_stamp_id LEFT JOIN apr15_repr_corp ON apr15_repr_corp_id = apr16_repr_corp_id LEFT JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = apr16_repr_corp_id LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr16_appr_id WHERE apr16_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr16_appl_type IN ('1','2') AND apr16_reg_date IS NULL AND ( ( apr16_appr_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') NOT IN ('99','40') ) OR ( apr16_appr_id IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY apr16_appl_date DESC, apr16_stamp_doc_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr16_stamp_doc ( apr16_stamp_doc_id, apr16_company_id, apr16_reg_date, apr16_appl_type, apr16_stamp_id, apr16_repr_corp_id , apr16_doc_issue_qty, apr16_doc_use_qty, apr16_provide_co, apr16_purpose, apr16_note, apr16_appr_id ) VALUES ( #{stampDocId}, #{companyId}, #{r.regDate}, #{r.applType}, #{r.stampId}, #{r.reprCorpId} , #{r.docIssueQty}, #{r.docUseQty}, #{r.provideCo}, #{r.purpose}, #{r.note}, #{r.apprId} )

INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_date01, sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_long01, sys99_long02, sys99_long03 , sys99_string03, sys99_string04, sys99_string05, sys99_string06, sys99_date02, sys99_string07 , sys99_string08, sys99_string09, sys99_date03, sys99_long04 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{printPersonId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , apr16_reg_date , COALESCE(f_cdnm('CorpDocStampApplType', apr16_appl_type, apr16_company_id, #{startDate}::date), '') , COALESCE(CASE WHEN apr16_appl_type = '2' THEN COALESCE(apr15_corp_nm, sys01_company_nm) ELSE apr10_stamp_nm END, '') , COALESCE(apr16_doc_issue_qty, 0), COALESCE(apr16_doc_appl_qty, 0), COALESCE(apr16_doc_use_qty, 0) , COALESCE(apr16_provide_co, ''), COALESCE(apr16_purpose, ''), COALESCE(apr16_requester, ''), COALESCE(apr16_note, '') , apr16_appl_date, COALESCE(emp01_kor_nm, '') , COALESCE(apr01_title, '') , COALESCE(CASE WHEN apr01_appr_id IS NULL THEN null ELSE f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr16_company_id, #{startDate}::date) END, '') , apr16_reg_date, COALESCE(apr16_stamp_doc_id, 0)
AND apr16_appl_type IN ('1','2')
mapper.select: SELECT apr16_stamp_doc_id AS stamp_doc_id , apr16_appl_date AS appl_date , apr16_appl_emp_nm AS appl_emp_name , apr16_stamp_nm AS stamp_name , apr16_stamp_qty AS stamp_qty , apr16_stamp_out_yn AS stamp_out_yn , apr16_provide_co AS provide_co , apr16_purpose AS purpose , apr16_note AS note , apr16_appr_status_nm AS appr_status_name , apr16_stamp_seq AS stamp_seq , apr16_stamp_date AS stamp_date , apr16_appr_id AS appr_id , apr16_real_stamp_doc_id AS real_stamp_doc_id FROM () s ORDER BY apr16_stamp_doc_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_date01, sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04 , sys99_long01, sys99_text01, sys99_text02 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{printPersonId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , apr16_appl_date , COALESCE(apr16_appl_emp_nm, ''), COALESCE(apr16_stamp_nm, ''), COALESCE(apr16_stamp_seq, '') , CASE WHEN COALESCE(apr16_stamp_out_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '✓' ELSE '' END , COALESCE(apr16_stamp_qty, 0), COALESCE(apr16_provide_co, ''), COALESCE(apr16_purpose, '') FROM () s ORDER BY apr16_stamp_doc_id
